svg.aria-label: Inside a feed of people looking at Storyfeed's README, your look's picture shows a feed growing: one plain row gains avatars, a photo and a key-value card; five volunteers joining fold into one grouped row; photos arrive live and regroup with a strip of thumbnails; then one more booking arrives. Your look sits at the top of a long feed of looks at the README; then the next person's arrives above it, still in progress with a typing indicator, whose dots the camera dives into.
